name: copilot-studio-credits-feature-mix
description: Per-pattern assumed billable feature events for one benchmarked question, used to produce a deterministic estimated Credits-per-interaction figure. This is a forward estimate from each agent's known configuration (like the Microsoft Copilot Studio agent usage estimator), NOT live telemetry. The Power Platform admin-center consumption export remains authoritative for billed Credits.

A.note: Generative answer grounded on Azure AI Search knowledge. No connector/agent action, no tenant graph grounding.

A2.note: Generative answer + one agent action for the Foundry IQ Knowledge Retrieval (API) tool call. GitHub Copilot harness; treat the retrieval tool as one agent action.

C.note: Generative answer + one agent action for the REST lookup tool (api/lookup). When the deterministic lookup route fires without generation, count classic_answer instead.

B.front_door_agent: Ask HR Policy Agent B foundry
B.note: Generative answer + one agent action to call the connected Foundry external agent. The Foundry model tokens are billed SEPARATELY on the per-token USD lane (byo_foundry_tokens=true).

Hosted.note: Hosted front door mirrors Pattern B: generative answer + connected-agent action, with Foundry model tokens billed separately.

assumptions: One benchmarked question maps to one user message; multi-turn or retry inflation is not modeled.
agent_action counts are marked uncertain because Copilot Studio does not expose a per-interaction billable-event breakdown over Direct Line; confirm against the admin-center consumption grid.
Patterns whose Copilot Studio front door has no graded live run carry a configuration-only estimate; the Hosted front door was re-measured on 2026-08-18 at 86.7% success.
